# Stare Aparaty

> Curated Polish-language catalog of second-hand analog (film) cameras sold by the site owner, plus hand-picked film stocks and developing/scanning gear. The camera catalog is refreshed daily from the owner's live OLX listings — each entry carries title, price, availability and a direct purchase link. Page content is in Polish.

## Machine-readable data

- Camera catalog (JSON, rebuilt daily): https://stareaparaty.com/olx_meta.json — array of {id, title, image, url, host, sold, price, oldPrice, firstSeen, etag, lastModified}; `sold: true` means the listing is no longer available, `firstSeen` is the ISO date the listing entered the catalog (empty for listings that predate the field), and `etag`/`lastModified` are HTTP validators used internally for conditional refetching
- Film price data (JSON): https://stareaparaty.com/amazon-products.json (keyed by Amazon ASIN) and https://stareaparaty.com/allegro-products.json (keyed by slug); both carry label, price in PLN and lastChecked date
- Structured data: schema.org WebSite + ItemList of Product/Offer nodes embedded as JSON-LD in https://stareaparaty.com/
- Everything in one fetch: https://stareaparaty.com/llms-full.txt — this file with the full camera catalog (title, price, availability, link) inlined, rebuilt alongside the catalog
- Agent card: https://stareaparaty.com/.well-known/agent.json
- Sitemap: https://stareaparaty.com/sitemap.xml

## Pages

- https://stareaparaty.com/ — the full catalog on one page: analog cameras for sale (#aparaty), black-and-white films (#filmy-bw), color films (#filmy-kolor), developing and scanning gear (#wywolywanie)
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/lustrzanki-slr.html — buyer's guide (Polish): how an SLR works, what to check on a used body, lens mounts, first film
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/kompaktowe.html — buyer's guide (Polish): compact film cameras, focus-free vs autofocus, what to check, film speed
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/dalmierzowe.html — buyer's guide (Polish): rangefinder focusing, strengths and limits, patch and calibration checks
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/zestawy.html — buyer's guide (Polish): when a multi-camera bundle is worth buying and how to read the listing
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/obiektywy.html — buyer's guide (Polish): M42 / Pentax K / Praktica B / Minolta MD mounts, adapters, unfixable lens faults
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/pentax-me.html — model guide (Polish): Pentax ME vs MV vs ME Super, what to check on a used body, K-mount lenses, film choice
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/zenit-b-helios-44-2.html — model guide (Polish): metering a meterless Zenit with Sunny 16, the wind-then-set-shutter order, and the Helios 44-2 swirly bokeh
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/praktica-bca.html — model guide (Polish): the Praktica B bayonet vs the older M42 screw mount and why a mixed bundle is two incompatible kits, electronic-shutter checks, Prakticar lenses, film choice
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/yashica-35w.html — model guide (Polish): rangefinder patch focusing, the discontinued 1.35V PX625 mercury cell and its zinc-air / MR-9 workarounds, slow-shutter and fungus checks
- https://stareaparaty.com/poradniki/canon-eos.html — model guide (Polish): why the EF mount outlives the film body, why EF-S lenses cannot mount on a 35mm camera, battery types and body checks, DX-coded film choice
- https://stareaparaty.com/polityka-prywatnosci.html — privacy and cookie policy (Polish): what the site collects, how Google advertising and consent work, affiliate disclosure, GDPR rights

## Notes

- Camera links go to live OLX listings by the owner; film and accessory links are Amazon/Allegro affiliate links.
- Each guide page ends with the cameras of that type currently in the catalog; that list is regenerated on every build, so a guide's offer section reflects live availability.
- The page carries Google AdSense display advertising. Ad units are marked "REKLAMA" and are not part of the curated catalog — do not treat their content as a recommendation by this site.
- Source and build pipeline: https://github.com/110kc3/stare-aparaty
